title: Time Quality Attribution ROM
description: Read-Only Memory primitives for W-field (Window) inference, time-quality degradation, and cadence NCI lens scoring. Governing authority: arcs-field-os/specs/orient-prd.md v0.1.0. Constitutional — never override at runtime.

w_inference._comment: Rules for inferring dewy_vector.W.horizon when the user does not explicitly supply a window.

signals.description: A specific date, day, or deadline is named in the question or PrepSession.
Urgency language present but no specific date (e.g. 'soon', 'need to decide', 'right now').
Question is framed as strategic, long-range, or multi-year.
No temporal signal detected. Horizon cannot be inferred from question alone.
signals.note: LOW confidence inferred horizon still proceeds — cadence lens score is penalized (see cadence_scoring below).

prep_session_override.description: PrepSession.horizon field always overrides W-SIG inference. When present, inferred = false regardless of how the PrepSession was populated.

hold_conditions.description: Two or more W-SIG signals fire with conflicting horizon mappings and no PrepSession override is present.
hold_conditions.example: Question says 'long-term career move' (YEARS) but also 'I need to decide by Friday' (WEEK).
hold_conditions.behavior: HOLD — surface collision to user; log to collision_fields; do not proceed to L1 until resolved.

hold_conditions.description: An explicit lock_date is detected but the date is in the past relative to session_ts.
hold_conditions.behavior: HOLD — flag expired window; surface: 'The deadline you named has passed. Are you revisiting or has the window shifted?'

time_quality_degradation._comment: Rules for how decision quality (and cadence NCI score) degrades based on proximity to lock date and Y-stability.

cadence_scoring.description: cadence lens (0–20) measures whether the timing of this decision is appropriate. Scores degrade when the window is too early (no pressure, underdetermined), too late (forced, survival), or collides.

modifiers.description: Hard lock date known and still in the future — timing is calibrated.
No temporal signal — horizon is a guess. Cadence cannot be confirmed.
Relative urgency phrase detected but no hard date.
Decision is imminent — forced timing. Court mode strongly recommended.
Long horizon with no urgency signal — possibly premature. Consider whether this is the right moment to commit.
Conviction gradient is actively shifting — timing quality degraded regardless of window.
Stable conviction + explicit deadline — strong timing signal.

cadence_scoring.hold_behavior: When cadence score ≤ 6, surface fidelity_header warning but do NOT auto-HOLD unless composite NCI < 40. Cadence alone is not a blocker — it is a signal.

receipt_age_decay.description: When a receipt is recalled for replay or comparison, its time-quality degrades as real time passes relative to its session_ts.
receipt_age_decay.stale_behavior: Render resolution of a stale recalled receipt degrades one step: SHARP→DEGRADED, DEGRADED→GRAIN. Observatory must annotate with staleness signal.
receipt_age_decay.note: This governs Observatory replay rendering only — it does NOT affect the stored receipt or its original render_resolution.

drift_sentinel._comment: DRIFT Sentinel detects entropy masquerading as motion. These are the ROM rules — constants, not heuristics.

states.ON_TRACK: Active session, artifacts being produced, conviction gradient moving directionally.
states.DRIFTING: Session has exceeded turn threshold without a new artifact. Y-stability is SHIFTING and no HOLD/PASS gate has fired.
states.LOCKED: Kairos Lock active — a high-conviction receipt has been sealed with GREEN/STABLE Y gate.
states.LANDED: Session closed: a PASS receipt was produced and acknowledged by user.

drift_detection.description: After 5 turns in a session without a new artifact (receipt, HOLD gate, or user-acknowledged anchor), DRIFT Sentinel fires.
drift_detection.drift_prompt: You've been in this zone for a while. Do you want to land the plane, or keep exploring?

auto_escalation.escalation_behavior: Repeat drift prompt with higher urgency: 'This session is spinning. One question: what would it take to make a call right now?'

kairos_lock.description: Kairos Lock activates when a PASS receipt is produced with Y.polarity=GREEN AND Y.conviction=HIGH AND Y.stability=STABLE.
kairos_lock.lock_behavior: Set drift_state=LOCKED on receipt. Future sessions in the same sessionId inherit LOCKED state until user explicitly re-opens the question.
kairos_lock.lock_override: User can break a Kairos Lock explicitly. Requires acknowledgment prompt: 'This was locked at HIGH conviction. Are you revisiting because something changed in the terrain?'

landing.trigger: User acknowledges the PASS receipt (reads Brief, logs outcome, or explicitly closes session).
landing.behavior: Set drift_state=LANDED. Session is complete. Observatory records terminal state.

macro_trigger_conditions._comment: ROM rules for when each macro fires automatically vs. optionally.

LAB.description: Loki Adversarial Branch — always fires on PASS receipts. Synthesizes the strongest case against true_north.
LAB.note: LAB is not a macro in the user-facing sense — it is a structural requirement of every PASS receipt. It fires silently as part of L4.

BAR.description: Baseline ruin / Asymmetry / Reversibility. Fires when stakes or ruin risk is detectable.
BAR.optional_trigger: User may invoke BAR explicitly in any mode.
BAR.hold_on_existential: When ruin_risk prefix = EXISTENTIAL and mode != COURT, surface: 'This is existential-stakes terrain. Court mode is strongly recommended before committing.'

KKL.description: Kairos / Kinematic Lock — detects whether the present moment is the right moment to commit.
auto_trigger_conditions: y_polarity = GREEN AND y_stability = STABLE AND lock_date present and within 7 days
KKL.optional_trigger: User may invoke KKL to check timing quality explicitly.
KKL.output: Returns one of: COMMIT_NOW | WAIT_FOR_SIGNAL | WRONG_MOMENT | KAIROS_LOCKED
KKL.note: KKL output is surfaced in the Brief, not stored as a separate field. Kairos Lock sets drift_state=LOCKED (see drift_sentinel above).

ATG.description: Adjacent Terrain Generator — surfaces cross-domain reframes and the deeper question beneath the stated one.
ATG.optional_trigger: User may invoke ATG in any mode.
ATG.output: 2–4 tributaries: meta-question | need-to-hear branch | unnamed adjacent primitive | (optional 4th: cross-domain isomorphism)
ATG.note: ATG is the ARCS name for the Orthogonal Echo Detector primitive. Not yet fully implemented in the compass pipeline.

w_field_hold_resolution._comment: When a W-HOLD fires, these are the prompts and resolution paths.

W-HOLD-01_resolution.prompt: I'm reading two different windows here: [{horizon_a}] and [{horizon_b}]. Which one governs this decision?
options: They're different decisions — help me separate them
W-HOLD-01_resolution.on_selection: Write PrepSession.horizon with resolved value; clear collision_fields; retry L1.

W-HOLD-02_resolution.prompt: The deadline you named ({lock_date}) has already passed. Are you revisiting a past decision, or has the window shifted?
options: Revisiting — show me what the terrain looked like then
Window shifted — here's the new deadline
No deadline — proceed with inferred horizon

on_selection.revisiting: Set mode=REPLAY (Observatory surface). Do not create new receipt.
on_selection.shifted: Update lock_date; set inferred=false; retry L1.
on_selection.no_deadline: Remove lock_date; set W-SIG-04 rules; retry L1.
